lineageNote: 1.7.0 (2026-09-03): the runtime is each product's uat integration branch on the fixed projected port — platform.operate climbs the whole ladder (stack-up → locate → start-role → serve → attest), serve merges the session branch into uat and restarts idempotently by head, servers run detached with pid and log (scripts/serve-runtime.mjs), the lease is the merge order, RUNTIME_BUSY and INTEGRATION_CONFLICT; workspace.bind binds by ancestry (the served head contains the pinned commit); the audit takes a route input and a Served surface section; UAT snapshots carry isolation; the two-sessions-one-product law lives in one place; a ports projection schema with sessionSlots defaulting to 0.

entry.name: starci
entry.description: Complete one StarCi mission by freezing its scope, selecting the one operator that owns the outcome, and routing between operators on typed results until the outcome is proved or a person must decide.

tools.purpose: Read files and directories at the aliases the Context table names, at the frozen head.
Write files inside a routed checkout or an authority root.
Read and change repository state: heads, branches, worktrees, commits, merges, pushes.
Run declared commands: gates, builds, proofs, hooks, deployment plans.
Read public web pages to close one named gap in the evidence; results are references with URLs, never authority.
Produce artwork: a digital image from an image model, made to one stated claim. Rendering HTML is the visualize tool, not this one.
Render HTML for a person to look at: direction candidates, audit sheets, alternative comparisons, previews. No model grant is involved.
Drive a real browser against a served route: navigate, act, capture screenshots and DOM measurements.
Probe an endpoint: readiness, health, a served route, a GraphQL typename, a status page.
Read a package registry: the published Grammar, its version, its files.
Inspect or operate containers and images: compose services, GHCR images by digest.
Read or write objects in the content store (MinIO): curriculum, style references, published units.

Resolve a sealed credential by name at the moment it is used; never read, print or store its value. The value may enter the request body of the call that consumes it or the field of a form in a driven browser, and nowhere else: not a file, not a fixture, not a recorded command, not a screenshot, not a log and not a receipt.
Read or write the product database for verification: seeds, fixtures, is_uat records.

Serve a folder of static HTML on the loopback interface so a person can open it in a browser. The port is tried from 60000 upward to 60100 and the first free one wins; the receipt records the URL, the port, the folder and the pid under response/artifacts/host.json, and the server is stopped when the branch ends or is resumed. It never binds 0.0.0.0, so nothing it serves leaves the machine.

Hand an artifact to the person in the conversation, rendered when the client can (image, HTML) and as a path or URL otherwise, at the moment a decision or a verdict needs their eyes. A run that produced the artifact and said nothing served nobody: the artifact reaches the person where they are reading, not where the branch happened to write it.

stopCodes.meaning: A declared resource moved since the inventory was bound, so the plan describes a service that no longer exists.
stopCodes.resume: Re-observe the inventory; it must arrive with a new fingerprint.

stopCodes.meaning: A presentation property is present in the tree and no knowledge topic is bound for it.
stopCodes.resume: Bind the missing topic.

stopCodes.meaning: The exclusive lease on the flow directory is expired, foreign, or bound to another run, generation or origin.
stopCodes.resume: The orchestrator grants the lease again for this run.

stopCodes.meaning: The requested target state is unreachable from the observed head.
stopCodes.resume: Ask for a legal transition, or publish the intermediate state first.

stopCodes.meaning: The validated manifest is pinned to another release, and that substitution is how an unreviewed image reaches a reviewed target.
stopCodes.resume: Bring a manifest validated against this release.

stopCodes.meaning: The declared migration cannot be applied safely.
stopCodes.resume: Approve a migration boundary the backend owner can apply.

stopCodes.meaning: A resume adds no evidence, constraint, inventory, or approval delta.
stopCodes.resume: Bring a real delta.

stopCodes.meaning: No alternative survives the frozen constraints, or the only alternative fails an attack.
stopCodes.resume: Relax a constraint or stop.

stopCodes.meaning: Every candidate contradicts authority or fails a mandatory attack.
stopCodes.resume: Change the authority or the constraints; cosmetic variants are not a delta.

stopCodes.meaning: The remote carries commits the local ref does not, so the push is not fast-forward.
stopCodes.resume: The branch owner reconciles the divergence and a new head arrives.

stopCodes.meaning: A declared language edition leaves a published learning outcome uncovered.
stopCodes.resume: Rewrite the edition, or narrow the brief.

stopCodes.meaning: The direction needs an owner the declared ceiling does not authorize.
stopCodes.resume: Correct the owner ceiling.

stopCodes.meaning: A node that must be mutated lies outside the mutable owner ceiling, or the owner sets overlap.
stopCodes.resume: Correct the owner authority.

stopCodes.meaning: A touched aspect has no sibling family bound for it.
stopCodes.resume: Bind the missing pattern; guessing the family from memory is refused.

stopCodes.meaning: A claimed port is already held by another declared process, and holding it is not permission to reclaim it.
stopCodes.resume: Agree a port, or the holder's owner releases it.

stopCodes.meaning: Two predecessor receipts describe different source heads, so their union is a delivery nobody built.
stopCodes.resume: Supply one coherent predecessor set on one head.

stopCodes.meaning: A predecessor fingerprint no longer matches the frozen source.
stopCodes.resume: Bring a refreshed upstream receipt.

stopCodes.meaning: A required check is missing, unreadable, or failed after apply, and an unproved operation is not an operated one.
stopCodes.resume: Repair the service, then invoke again.

stopCodes.meaning: A declared proof could not be executed in this environment.
stopCodes.resume: Provide a working proof environment; a proof that could not run never becomes a pass.

stopCodes.meaning: The identity provider, the sealed credential or the store a UAT identity needs cannot be reached, so the account can be neither created nor used. A record that is merely absent is created; this code is for a dependency that is not there at all.
stopCodes.resume: Restore the provider, the sealed file or the store; never ask a person to sign in or to paste a credential.

stopCodes.meaning: Delivered source differs from the frozen coverage matrix.
stopCodes.resume: Correct the source, or revise the matrix.

stopCodes.meaning: The approved reversible actions ran out.
stopCodes.fallback: Take the rollback branch: restore rollbackIdentity by its exact digest, never by tag, and record the restored release under ## Fallbacks taken.
stopCodes.resume: Grant rollback authority, or approve an unsafe action.

stopCodes.meaning: Bounded research cannot close the business or interaction question the decision rests on.
stopCodes.resume: Supply the owning authority or a materially new reference.

stopCodes.meaning: A new or reconstruct direction named no reference standard, so the class the surface is aiming at is unstated and the taste lens cannot judge whether it landed there.
stopCodes.resume: Name at least one standard by class, with what is borrowed from it, and run the same direction again.

stopCodes.meaning: The resolution actually read differs from the resolution the request bound.
stopCodes.resume: Bind the current resolution, or resolve the tree again.

stopCodes.meaning: The independent review returned a revision.
stopCodes.fallback: Repair exactly the artifacts the review's findings name, by owning stage, record the round under ## Fallbacks taken, and reopen the review exchange for the next round.
stopCodes.resume: Nothing is asked of anyone; the branch revises and reviews again until maxReviewRounds is spent.

stopCodes.meaning: maxReviewRounds is spent and the review still returns a revision.
stopCodes.resume: Approve more rounds, or narrow the unit.

stopCodes.meaning: Rollback is required and its exact safe release no longer exists.
stopCodes.resume: Restore the safe release at its exact digest.

stopCodes.meaning: The rollout could not place the release on the target.
stopCodes.fallback: Take the recovery branch: apply only the approved reversible actions against the same release identity, one at a time, and record each attempt with its outcome under ## Fallbacks taken.
stopCodes.resume: Correct the target or the plan and roll out again.

stopCodes.meaning: The hydrated route disagrees with the closed portable route, or belongs to another Source.
stopCodes.resume: Correct the hydration.

stopCodes.meaning: No portable declaration names this project and role.
stopCodes.resume: Declare the route; this operator never repairs one.

stopCodes.meaning: The declaration exists but no local route projects it onto this machine.
stopCodes.resume: Hydrate the route on this machine.

stopCodes.meaning: The project or the routed frontend checkout identity is not verified.
stopCodes.resume: Bind the route again.

stopCodes.meaning: No published case matches the observed condition on a node.
stopCodes.resume: The knowledge owner publishes the case, and the tree is resolved again.

stopCodes.meaning: The integration branch of this route is leased by another session while it merges and restarts, so the head this binding needs is not served yet.
stopCodes.resume: Wait for the holder to release the lease, then bind again: the same endpoint serves the merged head next. The reason names the holding session, the operation it is in and the queue position.

stopCodes.meaning: The runtime owner registry is missing, stale, or not ready while the caller must consume it.
stopCodes.resume: Raise one coordination request to the registered owner and wait for a ready generation.

stopCodes.meaning: The endpoint does not serve the bound route, or the surface never reaches readiness.
stopCodes.resume: Whoever runs the service serves the bound route; this operator never starts one.

stopCodes.meaning: The target or the boundary of the surface is incomplete, so the UI contract cannot be closed.
stopCodes.resume: Freeze the scope.

stopCodes.meaning: The shared service or its provider cannot be reached.
stopCodes.resume: Restore the provider.

stopCodes.meaning: Source was designed, written or published outside a session: the branch has no step-N/parallel-M under a session folder with state.json and a validated request.json, or the session branch being published carries no done source-application response whose commits contain its head, or a frontend chain with an audit step has no frontend-surface-audit response with its screenshots.
stopCodes.resume: Create the session first — state.json and step-1/parallel-1/request/request.json, green under validate-request — and run the operators that owe the receipt; a session cannot be reconstructed after the fact.

stopCodes.meaning: The observed checkout head differs from the head request.json froze.
stopCodes.resume: The orchestrator freezes the head again.

stopCodes.meaning: The steady window never closed before the bounded deadline, and an assumed rollout is not a deployment.
stopCodes.resume: Observe a fresh series after the target recovers.

stopCodes.meaning: The direction decision declares no surface class, or one outside the vocabulary COVERAGE-1 Case 7 publishes, so every banded proof rule is left without a threshold and no topic can be judged.
stopCodes.resume: Decide the direction again with a declared surface class, then audit at the same commit.

stopCodes.meaning: An identifier outside the bound rule inventory was reached for.
stopCodes.resume: Bind the topic that publishes it, or correct the identifier.

stopCodes.meaning: The runtime met a code the merged registry does not list.
stopCodes.resume: Register the code or fix the operator.

stopCodes.meaning: A file or a value the write would produce lies outside what was authorized, or the committed tree is not the resolved tree.
stopCodes.resume: Declare a corrected write set, or publish a resolution that carries the value.

when.en: Server behaviour, an API contract, persistence or a job changes for one business feature; the architecture is decided first and the promise is reconciled after the code lands. This chain writes no surface, so it carries no frontend.surface.audit and no uat.verify: uat.verify requires a frontend-surface-audit input and a bound fe route, and neither exists here. A feature whose promise reaches a person through a screen is not this workflow — it is full-feature, which walks the journey before it publishes.
when.vi: Hành vi server, contract API, persistence hay job đổi cho một feature nghiệp vụ; kiến trúc quyết trước, lời hứa được đối chiếu sau khi code đã vào. Chuỗi này không ghi bề mặt nào nên không mang frontend.surface.audit và không mang uat.verify: uat.verify cần đầu vào frontend-surface-audit và một route fe đã bind, ở đây không có cái nào. Một feature mà lời hứa chạm tới người qua màn hình thì không thuộc workflow này — nó là full-feature, nơi hành trình được đi trước khi publish.

when.en: One curriculum unit needs its brief, its language editions, its code tracks and an independent review; publishing to MinIO stays with a person.
when.vi: Một đơn vị giáo trình cần brief, các ấn bản ngôn ngữ, track code và một lượt review độc lập; đưa lên MinIO vẫn là việc của người.

when.en: A page, flow, or surface that does not exist yet must be created; the person named the target route and its business promise is known or will be decided first.
when.vi: Một trang, luồng hay bề mặt chưa tồn tại cần được tạo; người dùng nêu route đích, lời hứa nghiệp vụ đã có hoặc sẽ được quyết trước.

loops.when: an application-owned node fails a claim or a proof rule
the taste lens is fix-first, so the composition is decided again rather than revalued

when.en: An existing surface is rebuilt: composition, region order, hierarchy or responsive structure change while business facts, behaviour and API semantics stay.
when.vi: Dựng lại một bề mặt đã có: đổi composition, thứ tự vùng, hierarchy hay cấu trúc responsive trong khi fact nghiệp vụ, hành vi và API giữ nguyên.

loops.when: an application-owned node fails a claim or a proof rule
the taste lens is fix-first, so the composition is decided again rather than revalued

when.en: The approved structure of a surface stays; only typography, spacing, labels, controls, states, tokens or Grammar conformance inside it are repaired.
when.vi: Cấu trúc đã duyệt của bề mặt giữ nguyên; chỉ sửa typography, spacing, label, control, state, token hay conformance Grammar bên trong.

loops.when: an application-owned node fails a claim or a proof rule
the taste lens is fix-first, so the composition is decided again rather than revalued

when.en: A frontend change must also be walked by a real person's journey before it is published; a person asked for the UAT run by name.
when.vi: Một thay đổi frontend còn phải đi qua hành trình của người thật trước khi publish; có người yêu cầu đích danh lần chạy UAT.

loops.when: an application-owned node fails a claim or a proof rule
the taste lens is fix-first, so the composition is decided again rather than revalued

when.en: One feature needs both a backend contract and a new frontend surface; backend implementation and frontend direction run side by side after the architecture is decided.
when.vi: Một feature cần cả contract backend lẫn bề mặt frontend mới; hiện thực backend và hướng frontend chạy song song sau khi kiến trúc đã quyết.

loops.when: an application-owned node fails a claim or a proof rule
the taste lens is fix-first, so the composition is decided again rather than revalued

when.en: A published head must reach production: verify it, deploy it, and prove the steady state; recovery and rollback are inside release.deploy.
when.vi: Một head đã publish phải lên production: kiểm, deploy và chứng minh trạng thái ổn định; phục hồi và rollback nằm trong release.deploy.

when.en: A delivery that is already published must be verified on another stack before it is released: the same head is observed and walked there, and the chain ends with the two receipts in a person's hands rather than with a deployment.
when.vi: Một bản giao đã publish phải được kiểm trên một stack khác trước khi release: cùng một head được quan sát và đi qua ở đó, và chuỗi kết thúc bằng hai biên nhận trong tay một con người chứ không bằng một lần deploy.
